The season began on 7 February and ended on 14 December 2025.{{Cite web |last=Figueroa Loayza |first=Diego |url=https://rpp.pe/futbol/descentralizado/liga-1-2025-cuando-comenzara-la-primera-division-del-futbol-peruano-universitario-alianza-y-cristal-noticia-1598114 |title=Liga 1 2025: ¿cuándo comenzará la nueva temporada en la Primera División del fútbol peruano? |trans-title=2025 Liga 1: when will the new season in the First Division of Peruvian football begin? |publisher=[[Radio Programas del Perú|RPP]] |language=es |date=13 November 2024 |access-date=19 November 2024}} The fixture for the season was drawn on 14 January 2025.{{Cite web |last=Chavez |first=Erick |date=2025-01-14 |title=Sorteo de Liga1 Te Apuesto 2025: así quedó el fixture del torneo de Primera División peruano |trans-title=2025 Liga1 Te Apuesto draw: this is how the Peruvian First División tournament fixture turned out |publisher=[[Radio Programas del Perú|RPP]] |url=https://rpp.pe/futbol/descentralizado/sorteo-fixture-liga-1-2025-hoy-en-vivo-a-que-hora-inicia-y-que-canal-tv-transmite-evento-calendario-apertura-y-clausura-universitario-alianza-lima-sporting-cristal-noticia-1609710 |access-date=2025-01-14 |website=rpp.pe |language=es}} The defending champions [[Club Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]] won their twenty-ninth league title and third in a row by winning both the Apertura and Clausura tournaments, clinching the national title after defeating [[Asociación Deportiva Tarma|ADT]] 2–1 on 26 October.{{cite web |url=https://larepublica.pe/futbol-peruano/2025/10/25/universitario-vs-adt-tarma-en-vivo-por-el-torneo-clausura-de-liga-1-via-liga-1-max-2009300 |title=¡Universitario es el tricampeón de la Liga 1! Cremas vencieron a ADT en Tarma y lograron su estrella 29 |trans-title=Universitario are the three-time Liga 1 champions! ''Cremas'' defeated ADT in Tarma and clinched their 29th star |publisher=[[La República]] |language=es |date=26 October 2025 |access-date=26 October 2025}} On 19 August 2025, the [[Peruvian Football Federation]] officially announced the disqualification of [[Deportivo Binacional FC|Binacional]] from Liga 1 and the [[2025 Torneo Juvenil Sub-18]], following a court ruling that annulled the injunction which had allowed the club to return to the first division after its relegation in [[2023 Liga 1 (Peru)|2023]]. In its statement, the FPF stated that the Juliaca-based team would be informed about its participation in future tournaments in due course.{{cite web |url=https://larepublica.pe/deportes/2025/08/19/fpf-confirmo-descenso-de-binacional-de-la-liga-1-con-lapidario-comunicado-definitivamente-excluido-332443 |title=FPF confirmó descenso de Binacional de la Liga 1 con lapidario comunicado: "Definitivamente excluido" |trans-title=FPF confirmed Binacional's relegation from Liga 1 with a damning statement: "Definitely excluded" |publisher=[[La República]] |language=es |date=20 August 2025 |access-date=20 August 2025}} Aside from Binacional, [[Ayacucho FC|Ayacucho]] and [[Alianza Universidad]] were both relegated to [[2026 Liga 2 (Peru)|Liga 2]] on sporting performance at the end of the season.{{cite web |url=https://elcomercio.pe/deporte-total/futbol-peruano/descendidos-liga-1-2025-con-ayacucho-fc-estos-son-los-equipos-que-perdieron-la-categoria-noticia/ |title=Entre lágrimas: Con Ayacucho FC, estos
